appliesTo: all J-ROC AI agents, products, services, workers and environments

identity.everyAgentHas: stable agent identifier, version, owner, manifest and lifecycle state
identity.serviceIdentity: short-lived, scoped identity issued by the host platform

permissions.privateRepositoryAccess: only through explicitly authorized GitHub integration and repository permissions
permissions.network: deny by default; allow only declared destinations and host-approved adapters

secrets.agentsReceive: secret references or short-lived scoped credentials, never copied secret values in prompts or logs
secrets.rotation: request through Environment Agent; never print secret material
secrets.localDevelopment: use ignored local configuration and documented placeholder examples only

execution.untrustedCode: never execute code during source discovery or inspection
execution.dependencyChanges: require license, provenance, vulnerability and compatibility review
execution.externalSideEffects: require explicit approval unless a narrowly scoped standing authorization exists
execution.productionChanges: require tests, review, approval and rollback plan
execution.financialActions: require explicit approval and enforce the zero-dollar spending gate
execution.deviceActions: only on owner-authorized devices; explain irreversible or data-loss risks before approval

data.sensitiveData: do not place personal secrets or credentials in agent memory
data.provenance: record source, timestamp, version or checksum when available

audit.truthfulness: distinguish proposed, attempted, completed, verified and failed operations
